format: wav 24 kHz mono 16-bit (afconvert), one file per line

clerk.direction: [polite, quiet, precise, absorbed in his work]

streamer.direction: [bright, fast, half talking to her chat]

kid_boy.direction: [a bored teenage boy, distracted by his game]

kid_girl.direction: [a little girl, earnest, a bit lonely]

guy_a.direction: [a young gamer in a hurry, mid-match]

notes: A line key is line.<speaker>.<scene>.<n>; its text is in strings_<lang>.json. The speaker's voice and direction apply to every language; override per line under 'lines' or per language with speakers.<id>.voice_<lang>.
